title: SCNet P0 R06h 800 m/s no-mass-scaling TSSFAC confirmation
purpose: Confirm that the 0.4-to-0.2 local agreement lies on a stable fine-timestep plateau by one additional factor-two refinement to TSSFAC=0.1 while DT2MS remains zero.

provenance.identity_rule: Mesh, coordinates, connectivity, IDs, PIDs, initial state, material, EOS, contact, section, boundary conditions, speed, termination, output cards, resource contract and every CONTROL_TIMESTEP field except TSSFAC remain identical to returned Job 72639935.

symmetry.validity: normal incidence, face-on cube, centered impact only

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_binary_policy: Set NEIPH=6 and explicitly preserve all other R15.0.2 documented Card 1/Card 2 defaults; Card 2 is mandatory.

damage_source.sentinel_policy: absolute value at or above 1e29 is unavailable with a reason, never zero

shared_measurement_upgrade.database_extent_d3part_policy: Explicit NEIPH=6 request is a redundant-channel experiment; full D3PLOT HVAR6 remains authoritative.

paired_experiments.question: Does a factor-two TSSFAC reduction from 0.2 to 0.1 preserve the 800 m/s no-confirmed-crossing diagnostic response?

preregistered_evaluation.primary_comparison: r06h_0800_tssfac01 versus platform Job 72639935 using no-crossing-aware convergence gates
preregistered_evaluation.support_condition: Target R15.0.2 parses and terminates normally at one node/32 ranks; required outputs pass; qM/qP/qE absolute differences are each <=0.01; deleted-upstream mass-fraction difference is <=0.01; and qV is either within 5% when available in both runs or not applicable because both runs have zero confirmed crossing mass.
preregistered_evaluation.refute_condition: Parser/runtime/resource failure, missing required output, mass scaling, nonfinite evidence, response/deleted-mass disagreement, or asymmetric qV availability.
preregistered_evaluation.secondary_diagnostics: Energy, negative-volume topology, alive masks, HVAR6 and NCFORC are reported as mechanism evidence and do not replace the primary gates.
preregistered_evaluation.claim_boundary: Agreement would support selecting a local timestep policy for this single 800 m/s case only, not material truth or dataset admission.

submission_sequence.wave_0_gate: Zero KEY errors, 1 node/32 ranks, normal termination, no mass scaling, run-integrity PASS, readable D3PART/full-D3PLOT HVAR6/NCFORC, and the preregistered no-crossing-aware comparison against Job 72639935.
submission_sequence.hold_after_wave_0: Do not submit 2000 m/s or any treatment until the returned TSSFAC=0.1 confirmation is audited and the production timestep strategy is explicitly selected.
submission_sequence.resource_identity: Use exactly one node, 32 ranks, LS-DYNA R15 MPP double precision, and the same memory settings as Job 72639935.

deferred_not_generated.reason: Hold until the TSSFAC=0.1 confirmation diagnostic is audited.

claim_boundary: Job 72639935 passed the frozen 0.4-versus-0.2 local timestep-refinement gate for one 800 m/s case.
This package changes only TSSFAC from 0.2 to 0.1 and keeps DT2MS=0.
The current fragment-plate model already begins from a post-explosion fragment state, so no pre-explosion phase is added.
A null qV is not zero and is only a convergence non-applicable case when both runs have zero confirmed crossing mass.
Static PASS and normal termination do not establish physical validity, P0/P1 admission, engine or damage-tree fitting, or dataset-label admission.

explosion_instant_start_policy.r06h_rule: initial geometry, velocity and all other state remain byte-equivalent to Job 72639935
explosion_instant_start_policy.future_full_warhead_rule: A full-warhead high-fidelity model may start at explosion time only after the mapped mass, momentum, energy, fragment-state and boundary-state transfer is frozen and audited.
